note: Survey links stay hidden until survey.baseUrl is a real https URL. The app then appends ex, phase, and v as in survey.placeholderUrl. Student names, IDs, emails, and self-generated codes stay out of the URL. Usage metrics stay off, and make no network call, until metrics.endpoint is a real https URL. placeholderUrl and placeholderEndpoint are labeled examples only. Leave version empty until a release is tagged.
